en_quote: Sanctions evasion can serve as a predicate offense for money laundering, highlighting the interconnected nature of financial crimes.
knowledge_zh: 制裁规避可作为洗钱的上游犯罪，体现金融犯罪的关联性

en_quote: Criminals might use shell companies to mask illicit activities and circumvent sanctions restrictions.
knowledge_zh: 犯罪分子利用壳公司掩盖非法活动并规避制裁

en_quote: Complex financial strategies can obscure prohibited activities such as nuclear weapons development.
knowledge_zh: 复杂金融策略可掩盖核武器开发等被禁活动
